blocks.text: Match preview: Victoria face South Australia in 1st Match (TEST) on Wed, 7 Oct, 2026, 5:00 am at Junction Oval Melbourne. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Drizzle · High 16°C / Low 10°C · Rain: 0.6 mm · Wind: up to 27 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
